title: Settings
description: Text size, theme, playback speed and language for Lectio. Preferences stay on this device.
intro: There are no accounts. Your preferences are saved in this browser and never leave this device.
notSaved: This browser is not letting Lectio save settings, so they will reset when you leave.

textSize.preview: Notes on history and the original languages will read at this size.

theme.hint: System follows your device's light or dark setting.

speed.hint: Where the Listen queue starts. You can still change it while listening.

offline.hint: Removes days and audio saved for reading offline. Your settings are kept.
offline.unsupported: This browser keeps no offline data for Lectio.
offline.failed: Offline data could not be cleared. Try again, or clear site data in your browser.
